name: app-design-process-timeline-with-large-circles
title: Four-week design process shown with big overlapping hairline circles
whatItIs: A near-white slide with a headline mixing regular sans and bold italic serif. Four huge thin-outlined circles overlap across the page, each holding a small week tag, a phase title (Discover, Define, Structure, Design) and a two-line description, with small square nodes on the outlines.
whatItMeans: Elegant and airy; oversized circles suggest an ongoing cycle rather than a rigid list.
techniques: Use giant hairline circles as containers for phases.
Mark connection points with small square nodes.
Tag each phase with a tiny week pill.
Mix regular and italic serif in the headline.

vocabulary.definition: A very thin circular outline used as a container.
A small square or dot on a line.
A small label naming a stage or week.
Circles that intersect to imply flow.
